title: Requests change the CPU utilization scaling calculation
method: Synthetic simplified HPA calculation: 4 pods each use 375m CPU; target utilization is 50%. At a 500m request, utilization is 75% and ceil(4*75/50)=6. At a 1000m request, utilization is 37.5% and ceil(4*37.5/50)=3. Excludes real controller safeguards; not a resize recommendation.
alt: Requests change the CPU utilization scaling calculation. Illustrative values: Current replicas 4 replicas, 500m request target 6 replicas, 1000m request target 3 replicas.
